_comment: Where an ANNOUNCED presale stands: 'announced' (before it opens), 'live' or 'ended', read from the record's opens_at / closes_at and the clock. Both readers take the same answer from these cases: the website (app/public/js/token-page.js presalePhase, app/test/the_token_page_names_one_mint.test.js) and the bot (bot/formatters/token_card.py presale_phase, tests/test_the_token_card_reads_the_one_record.py). A window that cannot be read (absent, null, not a whole UTC minute, a date that does not exist, closing before it opens) says nothing about live or ended: the phase is the record's own status, 'announced', which is true of a sale that has opened too. Any status but 'announced' has no phase (null): the reader prints that status, as it always did. The hard cap can end the sale before closes_at; neither reader can see that without the chain, so both say 'or until the hard cap' beside the time.
